solution:
Let $u=3^{x}$. Then $3^{2x}=u^{2}$, so the equation becomes
$$u^{2}-4u+3=0\quad\Rightarrow\quad (u-1)(u-3)=0.$$
Thus $u=1$ or $u=3$.
If $u=1$: $3^{x}=1$ gives $x=0$.
If $u=3$: $3^{x}=3$ gives $x=1$.
So $x=0$ or $x=1$.
hints: Substitute u = 3^x to get a quadratic.
Convert the u-values back to x.
